objective: GATE 3E-C SOFTRESTAURANT SIDE-EFFECT CONTRACT. Descubrir en READ ONLY la logica observable alrededor de pagosproveedores: relaciones con compras/gastos/cheques/caja/banco/poliza, uso de enviadoacentral, comportamiento por forma de pago, modulos/triggers relacionados y mecanismos de cancelacion/reverso. No escribir ni ejecutar procedimientos. No implementar Payment Executor.

queries.name: e3c_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: e3c_modules_pagosproveedores
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%pagosproveedores%' ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: e3c_related_triggers
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(t.parent_id) AS parent_schema,OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) AS parent_object,t.name AS trigger_name,t.is_disabled,t.is_instead_of_trigger,sm.definition FROM sys.triggers t LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules sm ON sm.object_id=t.object_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'gastos',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'tempchequespagos',N'movtoscaja') ORDER BY parent_object,t.name

queries.name: e3c_dependency_graph
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(d.referencing_id) AS referencing_schema,OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) AS referencing_object,o.type_desc,d.referenced_schema_name,d.referenced_entity_name FROM sys.sql_expression_dependencies d LEFT JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=d.referencing_id WHERE d.referenced_entity_name IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'gastos',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'tempchequespagos',N'movtoscaja') OR OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'gastos',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'tempchequespagos',N'movtoscaja') ORDER BY referencing_schema,referencing_object,d.referenced_entity_name

queries.name: e3c_candidate_financial_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE N'%poliza%' OR o.name LIKE N'%caja%' OR o.name LIKE N'%banco%' OR o.name LIKE N'%cheque%' OR o.name LIKE N'%gasto%' OR o.name LIKE N'%pago%' ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: e3c_financial_module_links
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%pagosproveedores%' AND (sm.definition LIKE N'%chequespagos%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%movtoscaja%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%poliza%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%banco%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%gastos%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: e3c_shape_compra_gasto
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN foliocompra IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_foliocompra,SUM(CASE WHEN foliogasto IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_foliogasto,SUM(CASE WHEN foliocompra IS NOT NULL AND foliogasto IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_ambos,SUM(CASE WHEN foliocompra IS NULL AND foliogasto IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_origen FROM dbo.pagosproveedores

queries.name: e3c_enviadoacentral_shape
queries.sql: SELECT enviadoacentral,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.pagosproveedores GROUP BY enviadoacentral ORDER BY enviadoacentral

queries.name: e3c_reference_presence
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total,SUM(CASE WHEN referencia IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS referencia_vacia,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT referencia) AS referencias_distintas FROM dbo.pagosproveedores

queries.name: e3c_cheque_relation_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk INNER JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id INNER JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id INNER JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'gastos',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'tempchequespagos',N'movtoscaja') OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) IN (N'pagosproveedores',N'compras',N'gastos',N'chequespagos',N'chequespagosf',N'tempchequespagos',N'movtoscaja') ORDER BY parent_table,fk.name

queries.name: e3c_cancel_reverse_modules
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%pagosproveedores%' AND (sm.definition LIKE N'%cancel%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%elimina%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%revers%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%anul%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name
